parsed.name: SPIDR读出控制板
parsed.description: 用于通过以太网控制SPIDR板卡的读出控制设备，常用于连接和管理Timepix/Medipix像素探测器。可执行板卡复位、偏压与供电控制、快门触发、时钟与定时器同步、读出模式切换，并读取温度、湿度、压力、风扇转速和计数器等状态信息。
parsed.description_en: An Ethernet-controlled SPIDR board used to operate and read out Timepix/Medipix pixel detectors. It supports board reset, bias and power control, shutter triggering, clock and timer synchronization, readout mode selection, and monitoring of temperatures, humidity, pressure, fan speeds, and counters.
